• Scientific name: Leptoancistrus canensis (Meek & Hildebrand, 1913)
  • Synonym: Ancistrus canensis
  • Type locality: Río Cana, Cana, Darien, Panama.
  • Identification: the genus Leptoancistrus is characterized by having one or more very long cheek odontodes, and lacking adipose and anal fins.
  • IUCN Red List: Least Concern (last assessed 2019).
Central America: Pacific drainages of eastern Panama and Armila River on the Atlantic slope.
Breeding: unreported. There is no breeding report.
Field Museum of Natural History, Publications, Zoölogical Series v. 10 (no. 8), pp 80.
